agenda.seElPrimero: Be the first to say you’re going
agenda.sinResultadosAyuda: Try another name, a neighborhood or a music style.

experiencias.subtitulo: With Rio Diferente, a local tour operator.

tours.detalle: Christ the Redeemer, Sugarloaf, favelas and more

evento.iniciaSesionTexto: To say you’re going, sign in from the Profile tab.
evento.marcaSiVas: Say you’re going to join the list and meet other travelers.

chat.sinSesion: Sign in from the Profile tab to join the channel.
chat.seBorraHora: This channel is deleted when the event ends ({{hora}})
chat.seBorra: This channel is deleted when the event ends
chat.teVen: When you post, others can see your name, photo and country.
chat.vacioIdioma: No messages in this language yet. Say hi!
chat.silenciado: Several people reported your account. You can't post while we review it.
chat.citaNoDisponible: That message is no longer available
chat.soloAvisos: Announcements channel: only its creator can post here.

editarPerfil.errorNombre: Enter your first and last name.
editarPerfil.intro: This is how other travelers will see you in event channels.
editarPerfil.fotosPie: Up to {{max}} photos. Tap one to remove it.
editarPerfil.datosPie: Your birth date is never shown. You must be 18 or older.
editarPerfil.soloInicial: Show only my last name’s initial
editarPerfil.nacimientoUnaVez: Your date of birth can only be set once.
editarPerfil.nacimientoBloqueado: Your date of birth can't be changed.
editarPerfil.instagramPie: Optional. People you talk to in channels will be able to open your Instagram profile.
editarPerfil.mostrarEdad: Show my age to channel creators
editarPerfil.mostrarEdadPie: Your age doesn’t appear in chats. Only the creator of a channel you’re in can see it, so they know who joins their group. If you hide it, only the Bora team will see it.
editarPerfil.desdeArchivos: Can’t find your photo? Pick it from Files

ciudad.texto: We'll show you events and channels in that city.

canales.explicacion: One channel per event: it opens 3 days before and disappears when it ends.
canales.prontoAyuda: Say you're going and we'll let you know when it opens.
canales.vacioAyuda: Each channel opens 3 days before its event.
canales.pideClave: This channel is private. Ask the person who invited you for the password.
canales.nuevoIntro: Create a channel inside this event: a pre-party, a group to go together or a service for travelers. It closes when the event ends.
canales.descripcionPie: Optional. Shown at the top of the channel.
canales.clavePie: Only people with the password can join. Share it along with the link.
canales.librePie: Anyone at the event can join.
canales.creadoPrivado: Done. Share the link and the password with the people you want to invite.
canales.creadoLibre: Done. Share the link to invite other travelers.
canales.abreEl: It's a channel of "{{evento}}". It opens on {{dia}} at {{hora}}.
canales.misVacio: You're not in any channel yet
canales.misVacioAyuda: Tap “Join” in a channel and it will show up here so you can come back fast.
canales.mantenerParaSalir: Press and hold a channel to leave it.
canales.salirAyuda: It won't show up here or count new messages. You can come back anytime from the event.
canales.salirClave: It won't show up here. To come back you'll need the password again.
canales.creadorNoSale: You created this channel: you can't leave it, but you can close it from its options.
canales.elegirEventoAyuda: Your channel lives inside the event's channel and closes when it ends.
canales.sinAbiertos: There are no open channels in {{ciudad}} right now. Each channel opens 3 days before its event.
canales.unido: Done, you'll see it in My channels
canales.unirmeAyuda: Join to keep it in My channels and see new messages, even if you don't write.
canales.soloAvisosPie: Only you post; everyone else reads, reacts and votes. Handy for times, meeting points or changes.

normas.intro: Channels are for meeting other travelers and making plans for the event. To keep them a good place:

visible.texto: When you post, your name, photo and country are shown.

negocios.texto: Don't post sales, services, links or outside business contacts.

respeto.texto: No insults, harassment, discrimination or unwanted sexual messages.

reportar.texto: Press and hold a message or tap someone's photo to report them.

normas.consecuencia: If you don't follow these rules, your account will be suspended.

verificacion.porQue: To create channels and join private channels (pre-parties, closed groups) we ask you to verify your age. That way everyone knows ages are real.
verificacion.paso1: A photo of your passport or ID
verificacion.paso2: A selfie to confirm it's you
verificacion.paso3: Done: your age shows a verified badge
verificacion.privacidad: Didit, a service that specializes in identity checks, does this. Bora doesn't keep the photo of your ID: only your date of birth and that the check passed.
verificacion.paraEntrar: This channel is private. To join private channels you need to verify your age: it takes a couple of minutes and you only do it once.
verificacion.paraCrear: To create channels you need to verify your age: it takes a couple of minutes and you only do it once.

aprobada.texto: Done. Your age ({{edad}}) shows the verified badge and you can now create channels and join private ones.

en_revision.texto: Your check is being reviewed manually. It usually takes a few minutes; check again later.

pendiente.texto: We don't have the result yet. If you're done, check again in a few seconds.

rechazada.texto: We couldn't verify your ID. Make sure the photo is sharp and without glare, and try again.

aqui.quitar: Tap again if it was a mistake or you've left.
aqui.nadie: No one has checked in yet. Let others know when you arrive.
aqui.listo: Done, others can see you're here
aqui.quitado: You no longer show up at the venue

bloqueos.puntoMensajes: You'll stop seeing their messages in every channel, and they won't show up in people lists.
bloqueos.puntoNoLeidos: What they write won't count as new messages.
bloqueos.puntoDeshacer: You can undo it anytime in Profile → Blocked people.
bloqueos.puntoVolver: You'll see their messages again in every channel.
bloqueos.puntoSinAvisoDesbloqueo: They won't be notified when you unblock them either.
bloqueos.pie: You don't see their messages in any channel and they don't know you blocked them. To block someone, press and hold one of their messages.

modoLento.intro: Useful when there are lots of people and messages go by too fast.
modoLento.puntoCada: Each person can send 1 message every {{tiempo}}.
modoLento.puntoEspera: If someone tries to write sooner, they'll see how long is left.
modoLento.puntoTu: You and the admins have no limit.
modoLento.puntoApagado: Everyone can write without waiting between messages.

perfilIncompleto.intro: So others know who they’re talking to. You’re missing:
